cites.quote: then the Last visit shows Dr B's name next to the June 2026 date

findings.suggested_fix: Use exact dates, e.g. 15 January 2026 and 10 June 2026, and assert 10 June 2026 with Dr B.
findings.text: Not fixed from attempt 1 (F-8): S-1 AC4 gives months (January 2026, June 2026), not dates, so the expected Last visit date is not exact.

cites.quote: when staff open the patient list with the filter on, then neither the page nor the GET /api/patients response shows any of that medical history
The Last visit column and the filter show no `medical history`

findings.suggested_fix: Make S-4 AC1 assert no medical history with the filter both off and on.
findings.text: REQ-12 covers the Last visit column, which shows with the filter off as well, but S-4 AC1 checks for medical history only with the filter on. A leak in the filter-off list query would pass.

rubric_items.reason: All 14 known REQs are traced (S-1 REQ-1..5, S-2 REQ-6..7, S-3 REQ-9..11 and 14, S-4 REQ-12..13, S-5 REQ-7..8, S-6 REQ-13); there are no assumed REQs.
Most stories deliver one outcome. S-4 still bundles the no-medical-history constraint with 'rest of list unchanged', and REQ-13 is now split across S-4 and S-6.

The earlier gaps are fixed: the leap-year cutoff, latest vs any Completed, a pinned local-midnight clock, the filter narrowing search/status, and filtering before paging. S-4 AC2/AC3/AC5 still rely on 'as before'. The medical-history AC only checks with the filter on.

20 per page, Asia/Kolkata, UTC+05:30, the 12-calendar-month cutoff and the leap-year 365-day cutoff come from the intent or are derived inline. I checked the arithmetic and it is correct. Other dates and counts are test fixtures.
Clear and consistent terms (not seen for a year, Never, Completed). S-1 AC4 gives months, not dates, and some Then clauses say 'as before the change'.
